children: NPK International Inc. (NPKI) filed a Form 8K - Director, Officer or Compensation Filing - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on September 14, 2026.

On September 11, 2026, the Board of Directors (the "Board") of NPK International Inc. (the "Company") appointed James Barton as Executive Vice President, Commercial Growth & Operations of the Company effective as of September 22, 2026, succeeding Lori Briggs, who will cease to serve in such role on September 14, 2026.

Mr. Barton brings more than two decades of leadership experience in strategic sales, account management, service operations, manufacturing and growth execution. He has most recently served as the President of Clear Water Services, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Tidal Vision, in which role he led growth initiatives, operational improvements, and integration efforts that strengthened revenue, margins, and EBITDA performance. He also previously held senior leadership roles with ZECO, Mayco Wellchem, and Baker Hughes, and holds an MBA in Corporate Entrepreneurship from Syracuse University and a B.A. in Communication and Marketing from Louisiana State University.
A copy of the press release announcing the appointment of Mr. Barton is attached to this Current Report on Form 8-K as Exhibit 99.1 hereto.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/71829/000007182926000050/nr-20260911.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/71829/000007182926000050/0000071829-26-000050-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
